sections.description: Per-user frontend toolbar visibility for administrators.
sections.changelog:
= 0.3.2 =
* Receive the licensing connection through the existing GitHub updater. Connect once under Settings → MTT updates for future official updates; installed features keep working.
* Show a clear connection status, shorter setup help and update access for installed plugins only.

= 0.3.1 =
* Use the shared MTT admin UI library for consistent controls, layouts and keyboard focus.

* Report protected update outcomes through the shared website connection without sending content or credentials.

= 0.3.0 =
* Share one website key across MTT plugins with encrypted storage and manual site approval.
* Protect official update delivery while keeping installed features working.

= 0.1.1 =
* Use simple Hide Admin Bar and Show Admin Bar controls, including a mobile account-menu fallback.
* Replace the old MTT Testing Tools widget while preserving existing per-user preferences.

= 0.1.0 =
* Add administrator-only, per-user frontend toolbar controls with a recovery link and nonce-protected preference updates.
